title: Amazon SQS to AWS Lambda
description: Create a Lambda function that subscribes to an SQS queue

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys deploys a Lambda function and an SQS queue. SQS invokes the Lambda function when new messages are available. The CDK application contains the minimum IAM resources required to run the application.

bullets.text: Choosing between messaging services for serverless applications.
Configuring a queue to trigger an AWS Lambda function

testing.headline: Testing
text: Use the AWS CLI to send a message to the SQS queue and observe the event delivered to the Lambda function:
1. Send the SQS message: aws sqs send-message --queue-url ENTER_YOUR_SQS_QUEUE_URL --message-body "Test message"
2. Retrieve the logs from the Lambda function: aws logs describe-log-streams --log-group-name '/aws/lambda/ENTER_YOUR_FUNCTION_NAME' --query logStreams[*].logStreamName.

cleanup.headline: Cleanup
text: 2. Confirm the stack has been deleted: aws cloudformation list-stacks --query "StackSummaries[?contains(StackName,'STACK_NAME')].StackStatus"
